intro: I hold a higher VET diploma in Network Systems Administration and have a real passion for science and technology.

I currently work on industrial automation projects, combining my background in systems and networks with Siemens PLC programming. In my spare time I build apps with Python and Kotlin at Relative Developers.

now.title: Right now
now.text: I program Siemens PLCs with TIA Portal for automotive production lines and build in-house Python tools to support the engineering team.

experience.intro: From systems administration to industrial automation.

roles.title: Junior PLC programmer
roles.text: I'm part of the automation team, working on industrial projects for automotive production lines. I program Siemens PLCs with TIA Portal and handle the configuration and commissioning of the related hardware: I/O modules, industrial network devices and safety components. I also build in-house Python tools to support the engineering work.

roles.title: Technical administrative officer
roles.text: I provided technical and administrative support for order management, supplier control, invoicing and documentation, ensuring traceability and compliance with internal procedures. I worked mainly with SAP and with Microsoft Excel for data analysis and reporting.

roles.title: Software approval specialist
roles.text: After finishing my dual training I joined the software approval team, where I validated software before it was packaged and distributed across the corporate environment.

roles.title: Software quality assurance (dual VET)
roles.text: In the quality department I reviewed the technical documentation of each incoming piece of software and verified that it worked in the corporate environment, checking compatibility, stability and compliance with internal requirements. This validation allowed the approval process to move on to packaging and distribution.

roles.title: Campus IT Services (work placement)
roles.text: I provided IT support to the Baix Llobregat Campus: computer maintenance, troubleshooting and writing technical records for follow-up. I also helped create multimedia content and provided technical support for the website.
